name: Pozo Cañada (Spain)
description: Vertically divided green and white, the green charged with the municipal arms of Pozo Cañada (a well between towers above a sheep on red).
history: Municipal flag of Pozo Cañada; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Pozo Cañada arms — well, towers and sheep
